title: Tokyo izakaya, night
prompt: A tiny Tokyo shop at night seen from across a narrow lane: a two-storey wooden izakaya with indigo noren curtains, red paper lanterns, frosted glass sliding doors, a glowing menu board, a vending machine on the left, a bicycle and potted plants in the foreground, power lines overhead, light rain on the street, cinematic photograph, 35mm
lighting: the red paper lanterns, the warm light behind the frosted glass doors and noren, the menu board, the vending machine, a small neon sign above the door, two upstairs windows

labels.summary: A rainy evening street scene featuring a traditional Japanese izakaya with warm glowing windows, lanterns, and a vending machine.
